checks.item: 1. Minimum wage and arithmetic (representative full-time annual floor)
checks.researched: 319,512 kr/yr = 26,626 kr/month x 12 (Svensk Handel / Handels retail agreement, age 18, from 2026-04-01); Sweden has no statutory minimum wage
checks.verified: 319,512 kr/yr. I downloaded Medlingsinstitutets xlsx of agreement floors: Svensk Handel + Handelsanställdas förbund Detaljhandelsavtal, 2026 age 18 = 26,626 kr/mån from 2026-04-01 (19 år 26,946; 1 yr experience 27,530). 26,626 x 12 = 319,512 exactly. MI confirms: 'Det finns inga lagstiftade lägstalöner i Sverige'.
checks.note: Arithmetic is exact. The choice of retail as the 'representative' floor is a judgement call: the same file shows lower floors (e.g. Unionen retail white-collar 22,355 kr/mån from 2026-05-01) and higher ones. 319,512 is a sensible mid-range blue-collar floor and the figure should be labelled a collective-agreement floor, not a legal minimum.

checks.item: 6. School-leaving qualification and how the result is scored
checks.researched: Gymnasieexamen (with slutbetyg), 3-year gymnasium. Letter grades A-F, A highest, E lowest pass, F fail; merit points A=20, B=17.5, C=15, D=12.5, E=10. Gymnasium jämförelsetal is a credit-weighted average, max 20.00, plus up to 2.5 merit points. A pass in 2,250 of 2,500 credits is needed. A 1-10 scale with no pass mark starts in 2028.
checks.verified: Confirmed by fetches. Skolverket: six grades A-F, A-E pass, F fail. Wikipedia (Academic grading in Sweden): A 20, B 17.5, C 15, D 12.5, E 10, F below 10; highest average 20.0. Swedish Wikipedia (Gymnasieexamen): at least 2,250 gymnasiepoäng, including Swedish and maths. Skolverket: a 1-10 scale with no pass mark takes effect 2028-07-01, with new merit values from 2031. Skolverket press release 2026-09-24: grade 9 merit value 230.9 of 340 over 17 subjects, 83.5% eligible for gymnasium. UHR: merit value of 19 or more on the Swedish scale gets 2.5 merit-point compensation.
checks.note: The 20/17.5/15/12.5/10 points and the 2,250-credit rule come from Wikipedia. UHR and antagning.se pages that would be the primary source returned 404 or no detail. The 0-20 scale and 2.5 merit-point cap are standard. The grade 9 merit scale (max 340, 17 subjects) is primary-sourced.

checks.researched: CSN studiemedel is a grant plus a loan; full-time 2026 is 3,398 kr/week (grant 1,030 + loan 2,368), or 13,592 kr per 4 weeks. Repayment starts at the earliest six months after study support ends, and always after a year-end. Interest accrues from first payout.
checks.verified: CSN table 2026, full-time: grant 1,030, loan 2,368, total 3,398 kr per week; 4 weeks = 4,120 + 9,472 = 13,592 kr. The raw page says 'Du börjar betala tillbaka lånet tidigast sex månader efter att du hade studiemedel. Återbetalningen startar alltid efter ett årsskifte.' Repayment size depends on amount borrowed, interest rate and age. SCB CPI for August 2026 was 0.3% (July 0.2%, CPIF 0.7%), so the colleague's real-rate arithmetic is right.
checks.note: One sub-claim is not backed by the page I read: 'the loan accrues interest from the first payout'. The CSN page does not say when interest starts, and an intermediate WebFetch summary that claimed the opposite was not supported by the raw page text. Treat that sentence as unverified and soften or drop it.
